. sunday hymn: hail redeemer king divine. hail, redeemer, king divine. priest and lamb, the throne is thine; king whose reign shall never cease, prince of everlasting peace! chorus: angels, saints and nations sing “praise be jesus christ, our king; lord of life, earth, sky and sea; king of love on calvary ”. king, whose name creation thrills, rule our minds, our hearts, our wills; till in peace each nation rings, with thy praises, king of kings. recruitment sunday for st paul's: volunteers need- ed! last weekend, we heard about opportunities to serve at st paul’s as collectors, eucharistic ministers, and readers. each role includes training, so you’ll feel confident and supported. sign up sheets are still availa- ble at st paul's this sunday. volunteers are scheduled for specific mass dates and times rather than every mass in a single weekend. please consider helping our parish community grow in faith and service. you can also sign up by emailing

. young adults - interested in a catholic community? if you’re looking for friends in faith, we’re exploring a catholic young adults group (ages 18–30) for our parish, to begin in october. the aim is to grow closer to god, deepen our faith, and journey together with oth-ers who want to keep christ at the centre of their lives. activities may include eucharistic adoration, holy hours of prayer, and faith-based social events. share your interest by scanning the qr code. questions:

ext 127 duty : fr anthony kerr funerals: fr robert bud this sunday at 4.00pm in the cathedral of christ the king, mullingar, the closing of the diocesan process for the cause of canonisation of fr. willie doyle sj, will take place after sung vespers. bishop deenihan said, "all are welcome to attend the ceremony. this will be a significant prayerful occasion, and after the ceremony, the process will move to the dicastery for the causes of saints in rome. the example of fr. doyle, an irish catholic jesuit priest who died serving as a british army chaplain in 1917, while ministering to soldiers of other christian denomination – as well as his commitment to promoting the gospel and vocations, and his spirituality which involved sacrifice – has much to offer our own time when nationality and denomination run the risk of polarity. to quote pope francis, ‘christians build bridges, not walls.’ sacramental preparation : enrolment ceremonies for confirmation candidates take place this weekend. we welcome all families to renew their commitment to the participation of their children in the life of the parish. parish collections: regular contributions through the envelope collection and/or standing order allow the parish to claim an income tax rebate on annual donations totalling €250 or more €5 per week). if you wish to become a contributor, please contact the parish office. junior legion of mary for boys and girls ages 7 to 16. tel
